summary: York County, SC tower registered with the NHLR as US 1477 in 2021; the register names the SC Forestry Commission as administrator but gives no build date, design or condition.

facts.status_note: The register lists the tower but gives no current condition, and no source read says whether it still stands
facts.agency: South Carolina Forestry Commission (listed as administrator by the register)

events.note: Registered January 8, 2021 as US 1477, SC 35; nominated by Si Ballenger

evidence.supports: administered by the South Carolina Forestry Commission
Forestry Commission closed its fire tower system on October 1, 1993
evidence.quote: The Forestry Commission closed its fire tower system on October 1, 1993.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only the register page supports any tower-specific fact: location, elevation, registration, nominator and administrator. No build date, design, staffing, fire history or condition was found in the sources read. The register names the Forestry Commission as administrator, yet the Commission closed its fire tower system in 1993; the sources do not explain the link, so the story says so. The record's 'standing' is not confirmed by any source read, so facts.status is 'unknown' and no correction is proposed. The Forest Lookouts page for this tower returned a 404. Searches used: 3 WebSearch calls for this tower, one over the 2-call budget, because the first results did not identify a build date. About 4 page reads. Verification pass: the SCFC history page was searched for Lesslie, York, Ballenger and the tower name and has no mention of this tower; the story now says so, and no longer says the landowner is the contact (the register names only the administrator).
